description: Send a verification email to a user to verify ownership of their email address identity. The user receives an email with a link to confirm their identity. Use when you need to verify a user's email address identity in Zendesk, such as when creating new users or resolving identity verification issues. Note: This action sends a verification email to the user's identity address.

inputSchema.description: Request parameters for requesting user identity verification.

user_id.description: The numeric ID of the user
user_id.title: User Id

user_identity_id.description: The numeric ID of the user identity to verify
user_identity_id.title: User Identity Id

inputSchema.title: RequestUserVerificationRequest

name: request_user_verification

RequestUserVerificationResponse.description: Response from requesting user identity verification.

sent_at.description: Timestamp when the verification email was sent
sent_at.title: Sent At

verified.description: Whether the identity has been verified. Returns true if verification email was sent successfully.
verified.title: Verified
